_source: FHWA Proven Safety Countermeasures (highways.dot.gov/safety/proven-safety-countermeasures). FHWA's site blocks automated requests, so each page was read from its Internet Archive copy (2024-2025 snapshots) on 2026-09-26. Figures are quoted as FHWA publishes them, including what each one measures; 'up to' figures are FHWA's own wording. Superscripts in FHWA's text are source notes on the page.
_applies_when: Conditions on the intersection's verified features (road_features.csv): signal yes/no, a leg missing a left-turn lane / crosswalk / median, share of crashes in the dark, lanes. A countermeasure is suggested only where its conditions hold.

_not_listed.protected_left_turn_phasing: Not an FHWA Proven Safety Countermeasure. Relevant where left-turn crashes are high and left-turn lanes already exist, but we quote no figure for it here; CMFs for it are in FHWA's CMF Clearinghouse and would need to be looked up and cited individually.
